history.overview: The Battlefield is the central war theater of the Wall of Slaughter, where Muramite squads clash with resistance enclaves amid Discord corruption.

timeline.name: Battlefield Seized
timeline.description: Muramite forces captured the central war zone and established roaming strike squads.

timeline.name: Resistance Enclaves Form
timeline.description: Resistance fighters established defensive pockets across the battlefield.

timeline.name: Discord Craters
timeline.description: Planar eruptions created Discord craters across the terrain.

timeline.name: Warfront Escalation
timeline.description: The battlefield became the most contested zone of the Wall of Slaughter.
